lines.say: In Super Mario Bros., the clouds and the bushes are the exact same picture.
It came out in 1985, designed by Shigeru Miyamoto and Takashi Tezuka, with music by Koji Kondo.
To save space on the cartridge, they recolored the cloud to make the bushes.
Use a glitch in World one-two, and you can reach the Minus World, a water level that never ends.
lines.cap: Use a glitch in World 1-2, and you can reach the Minus World, a water level that never ends.

lines.say: Get enough lives, and a crown shows up in your life counter.
The NES version alone sold over 40 million copies.
Did you ever find the Minus World? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
